turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on am, is and are?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Of course. Quick reminder: we use am with I, is with he, she and it (or one person or thing), and are with you, we and they. And in English we never leave this verb out, for example "He is tired", not "He tired".

Write am, is or are: My father ___ a pilot. (Answer with only the missing word.)
